_comment_about: This file is the only thing you need to edit by hand. Everything else is generated.
tagline: Web things, mostly TypeScript. Built small, shipped early, kept only if it works.
about: Self-taught, prototype-first. I'd rather have a rough thing running in front of someone this week than a clean thing running in front of nobody next month.
Public repos here are the ones I'm happy to have read. The rest stays private until it earns its place.
_comment_projects: Entries are merged with your public GitHub repos. 'repo' pulls name/description/language from the API; anything you set here wins. Entries without 'repo' are external projects.

projects.name: vantage-studio
projects.description: Two dozen hover, scroll and cursor interaction tiles in one page. A parts bin for landing pages.

projects.name: rockie
projects.description: Guided energy-advice chat. Walks through an assessment step by step and shows the maths behind every recommendation.

_comment_portrait: The ASCII portrait is rendered once from a photo and committed as SVG; the photo itself stays out of the repository. Re-render with: python3 profile/generate.py --photo ~/somewhere/face.jpg. ink: 'dark' draws the dark parts of the photo (right for a bright background), 'bright' draws the light parts (the other way round).
_comment_repos: include_private only affects the aggregate language stats; private repo names are never printed.
